notes.title: Version Update 1.1.0
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone, [/p][p]We are OrcaLayout. Today we're bringing you the 1.1.0 update for Raining City: Millions Recollections. Thank you all for your continued support! Below are the details of this version's update:[/p][p]1. Added new dialogue options for Huang Yijun at Lyu Xuan's home. After completing Yijun's story, new conversations can be triggered on the second floor of Lyu Xuan's house.[/p][p]2. Added 12 new concept entries (Requires a new playthrough to unlock).[/p][p]3. Introduced in-game news push notifications on the phone. Each time you complete a quest, you'll receive a new news update (Requires a new playthrough to unlock)[/p][p]4. Improved the Su Lingxi side quest ending presentation.[/p][p]5. Added a new CG illustration in Chapter 5 (This does not affect existing achievements)[/p][p]6. Fixed an issue where some players were unable to change resolution.[/p][p]7. Fixed a problem where certain settings would not save properly.[/p][p]8. Fixed abnormal prompts and red-dot indicators for concept updates.[/p][p]9. Corrected most errors related to voice lines, echoes, and missing audio. If you still encounter unsatisfactory dubbing or audio issues, please continue to share your feedback with us.[/p][p][/p][p]If you encounter any issues while playing, please feel free to share feedback in our official community [url="https://2pgames.net/discord"]2pgames.net/discord[/url]. We are committed to continuous updates until all problems are resolved. Thank you for your trust and support! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485373/0e942b8c1822054060812d84bae9764b514378a9.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Version Update 1.0.7
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone, this is OrcaLayout. We sincerely apologize for the unexpected issues that occurred after the launch of Raining City: Millions Recollections, and we greatly appreciate the players who continue to enjoy the game and support us despite these problems. [/p][p][/p][p]Version 1.0.7 has now been released, addressing several critical issues. Below are the details: [/p][olist][*][p]Achievement: Millions Recollections—This has been fixed. If the achievement does not unlock after obtaining all CGs, try acquiring any CG again. If it still doesn’t trigger, we recommend revisiting the coin-tossing event and trying both outcome options. [/p][/*][*][p]Issues causing black screen freezes or extended black screens without cutscenes have been resolved. Players who previously experienced long black screens are strongly encouraged to replay the corresponding sections to enjoy the full experience. If black screen issues persist, please leave a comment or contact us directly. [/p][/*][*][p]Errors such as misaligned, misplaced, or reverberant voice lines are being addressed. We are working with voice actors to re-record certain parts and correct sound effect errors. This is an ongoing process, and updated voice files will be released daily. We apologize for the inconvenience. [/p][/*][*][p]We are aware of and fixing erroneous red notification dots and repeatedly popping prompts on the right side of the screen. A solution will be deployed soon. [/p][/*][*][p]An issue preventing some players from switching resolutions will be fixed. [/p][/*][*][p]Occasionally, Simplified Chinese may appear in places outside the main text. This is being corrected. [/p][/*][/olist][p]Future Update Plans[/p][olist][*][p]Add dialogue options for Huang Yijun at Lyu Xuan’s home. [/p][/*][*][p]Expand endings for certain tales and mysteries. [/p][/*][*][p]Fix glossary entries not yet added to the in-game phone. [/p][/*][*][p]Enrich the game’s world through news updates and supernatural-themed public accounts on the phone interface. [/p][/*][*][p]Resolve narrative inconsistencies occurring in semi-free exploration mode.[/*][/olist][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485373/f24303b1b390d3dd6bf62b0879355ab5c7cf8d63.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485373/0e942b8c1822054060812d84bae9764b514378a9.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485373/4abe9dad2c6af003dbe7a51accf3849736854ba3.jpg"][/img][/carousel]If you encounter any issues while playing, please feel free to share feedback in our official community [url="https://2pgames.net/discord"]2pgames.net/discord[/url]. We are committed to continuous updates until all problems are resolved. Thank you for your trust and support! [/p]

notes.title: Raining City: Millions Recollections is now available!
notes.notes: [p] Greetings, everyone![/p][p][/p][p] We’re excited to share that Raining City: Millions Recollections is officially available starting today![/p][p] [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2529750/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]  Lyu Xuan awakens in the dead of night, her chest drenched in blood, a mysterious black hole opening in her palm. From that void, a staggering fortune—one hundred million strong—pours forth. But before she can grasp what’s happening, grotesque creatures lured by the wealth close in, swarming from every shadow. So begins a haunting tale set in a city shrouded in gloom. Come—meet us beneath the rain of Egret City! [/p][p][/p][h3]Recollections & Chrono bundle[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/58517/Recollections__Chrono/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Step into the bizarre, where mysteries unfold beneath the endless rain of a gloomy city. One protagonist, chosen by the will of the planet, bears the weight of suffering within the walls of a small school. The other, burdened with a "fortune" that bends the laws of reality, wanders the bustling streets of a coastal city in search of memories long lost.[/p][p]Different paths, yet the same haunting resonance. Both The Chrono Jotter and Raining City: Millions Recollections invite you into unforgettable journeys shaped by wonder, sorrow, and the surreal.[/p][p]Purchase the The Chrono Jotter & Raining City: Millions Recollections Bundle now to receive an exclusive discount—stacked with the release offer.[/p][p]Will we meet again—under the rain of Egret City, or within the shadows of the old school?[/p][p][/p][p]If you experience mixed voice-over during gameplay, we recommend temporarily disabling the Chinese voice option. A fix for this issue is already in progress and will be released soon.[/p][p]If you have any feedback or suggestions, please join us on [url="https://2pgames.net/discord"]discord[/url]. [/p]

notes.title: Let us meet beneath the rain in Egret City！
notes.notes: [p]"Raining City: Millions Recollections," a surreal and suspenseful adventure game, launches [b]August 26th[/b]. Let us meet beneath the rain in Egret City.[/p][p][/p][p] On the eve of the story, the heroines stand at the edge of fate. Each holds secrets. Yet far across Egret City, a girl named Lyu Xuan—long gone—will soon shake their world, and perhaps, rewrite its very course.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485373/354f4704e957a48d9779a259e91ac0b2331ac3b4.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 🔔 Don't miss out on our upcoming developer streaming event for Raining City 🌟
notes.notes:
Dear detectives,

We’re excited to announce that we are participating in Steam Next Fest from June 10th until June 17th!

During the Fes, there is a free demo available for everyone to give the game a try during the event and we’d love to read your feedback on it through our [url=https://discord.com/servers/2p-games-539635951513632768]Discord[/url]! (on Visual Novel Channel)


During the event, we will have two broadcasts where you can see the game being played by our team. Both of these broadcasts are pre-recorded and will be looped throughout the duration of Next Fest. You can also catch them while they are featured at the below times:

Next Fest Broadcast #1
Tuesday, June 11th at 8:00 PM PT

Next Fest Broadcast #2
Friday, June 14th at 8:00 PM PT

Don’t forget to wishlist the game so you don’t miss out on any news and thank you for all of your support so far!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2529750/Raining_City_Millions_Recollections/

notes.title: Rainning City: Million Recollectrions DEMO is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

This is RedGalileo from OrcaLayout, I am glad to share the news that our latest game <Raining City: Millions Recollections> has a DEMO released today, it will be ready on English.

It's still a tough translated version now, but I can't wait to share the new story with you, rest assured, we will continue polishing the game and release the official version as soon as possible, the translation improvement will release a few weeks later.

The Japanese version is coming, too.
Feedback: segaiduse@gmail.com

Meet you in the heavy rain of Heron City!
